answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring every new identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn trust, then slashing that stake when a trellis of mutually supporting accounts is exposed by shared funding, synchronized votes, or copied behavior. Honest identities recover their deposits; a fake cluster loses them. The attacker therefore must escrow real capital for each lotus-shaped branch, and a coordinated burst can burn the entire canyon of deposits.
